sn35.78:1.1: atha kho āyasmā rādho yena bhagavā tenupasaṃkami …pe… “yo kho rādha, anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.78:1.3: cakkhuṃ kho rādha anattā. tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.78:1.4: rūpā anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.78:1.5: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.78:1.6: cakkhusamphasso anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.78:1.7: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattā. tatra te chando pahātabbo …pe… jivhā anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo. rasā …pe… jivhā viññāṇaṃ …pe… jivhāsamphasso …pe… yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tampi …pe…
sn35.78:1.8: mano anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.78:1.12: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tampi anattā. tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.78:1.13: yo kho rādha anattā tatra te chando pahātabboti.
